svg.title: Lombardy study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Lombardy; 2: Sassella; 3: Maroggia; 4: Tirano; 5: Iseo; 6: Erbusco; 7: Scanzorosciate; 8: San Colombano al Lambro; 9: Sirmione; 10: Casteggio; 11: Milan; 12: Verona

g.title: 8 · San Colombano al Lambro: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
